I will do this plot much like last season, because sorghum can stand better when the rains are not perfect and I do not want to spend cash on things I may fail to buy on time. I will plant my local seed and mix in manure where I can, because that is what I know and what I have seen work nearby. I will not put chemical fertilizer, I will not irrigate, and I will clear weeds mostly with family hands. If work becomes heavy at weeding time, I will bring in a few laborers for some days.
